tools.name: start_claude_review
tools.description: Start a non-blocking review with the configured Claude model and immediately return a review ID. Use selectively for consequential plans, architecture choices, difficult debugging, security/correctness risks, substantial changes, or completion claims, not for routine work. Continue independent work while it runs, then call get_claude_review later. When workspace is supplied, Claude may inspect that trusted directory with its configured tools (permission mode: plan; safe mode: on). Omit workspace for a packet-only, tool-disabled review. Never include secrets or unrelated private data.

kind.description: The kind of second opinion requested; this selects the review rubric.

task.description: The goal, decision, or problem Codex is working on.

workspace.description: Optional absolute path to a trusted workspace Claude may inspect with the configured Claude Code tools. Omit for a packet-only, tool-disabled review.

artifact.description: Optional relevant plan, proposal, diagnosis, diff, code excerpt, test evidence, or draft answer. Required when workspace is omitted. Redact secrets and omit unrelated private data.

question.description: The specific uncertainty or challenge Claude should address.

focus.description: Optional review dimensions or constraints to emphasize.

tools.name: get_claude_review
tools.description: Check or retrieve a previously started Claude review. Call this after doing other useful work or before relying on/finalizing the reviewed decision; do not poll tightly. Omit review_id to retrieve the latest review in this Codex session.

review_id.description: Review ID returned by start_claude_review. Omit to retrieve the most recently started review.

tools.name: cancel_claude_review
tools.description: Cancel a running Claude review and terminate its Claude process group. Omit review_id to cancel the latest review. Use only when the review is no longer relevant or the user asks to stop it.

review_id.description: Review ID returned by start_claude_review. Omit to retrieve the most recently started review.
